settings.title: Fine Jewelry, Authentically Sourced
settings.subtitle: Thirty years in New York's Diamond District — designed here, crafted in Italy, and chosen the way I'd choose something for myself.
settings.story_heading: I Came Here With Almost Nothing
settings.story_p1: I came to America in my twenties and did what immigrants do — I worked. I trained as a nurse, and my husband and I raised our family. But what I had always wanted to be was an artist. So after the long shifts, when the house was finally quiet, I would sit down at the kitchen table and draw. The drawings kept turning into jewelry.
settings.story_p2: My first years in the trade were spent working alongside my brother Jacob at Diamond Quasar — the house the world now knows as Jacob & Co. I learned the Diamond District the only way you really can: from the inside, stone by stone, bench by bench. And then I did the thing that women like me were not expected to do in that industry, in those years. I opened my own company.
settings.story_p3: That was more than thirty years ago, and I still believe what I believed at that kitchen table: exceptional jewelry shouldn't require compromise. Whether it's newly made — designed here in New York and brought to life by master goldsmiths in Italy — or a rare estate piece from Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels or Tiffany & Co. that we've authenticated ourselves, everything carrying my name meets the same standard. The right piece is transformative: not only beautiful, but meaningful. Which is why I would rather understand what you're looking for than sell you something.
settings.cta_body: Whether you're celebrating a milestone, beginning a new chapter, or simply treating yourself to something extraordinary—we're here to help you find the piece that speaks to you.
